title.zh: 修正第410号法的法案，该法规定了莱潘托–本托省的建制，将该省秘书兼司库的薪金提高至每年1300美元，并将本托克副省长的薪金提高至每年1500美元
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND TEN, PROVIDING FOR THE ORGANIZATION OF THE PROVINCE OF LEPANTO-BONTOC, BY INCREASING THE SALARY OF THE SECRETARY-TREASURER IN SAID PROVINCE TO THIRTEEN HUNDRED DOLLARS AND THE SALARY OF THE LIEUTENANT-GOVERNOR OF THE SUB-PROVINCE OF BONTOC TO FIFTEEN HUNDRED DOLLARS PER YEAR.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND TEN, PROVIDING FOR THE ORGANIZATION OF THE PROVINCE OF LEPANTO-BONTOC, BY INCREASING THE SALARY OF THE SECRETARY-TREASURER IN SAID PROVINCE TO THIRTEEN HUNDRED DOLLARS AND THE SALARY OF THE LIEUTENANT-GOVERNOR OF THE SUB-PROVINCE OF BONTOC TO FIFTEEN HUNDRED DOLLARS PER YEAR.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 410 về tổ chức tỉnh Lepanto-Bontoc, tăng lương Thư ký-Kế toán lên 1300 đô la và lương Phó Thống đốc tiểu tỉnh Bontoc lên 1500 đô la mỗi năm
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่๔๑๐ว่าด้วยการจัดตั้งจังหวัดเลปันโต-บอนตอกโดยเพิ่มเงินเดือนเลขาธิการ-ผู้รักษาการคลังของจังหวัดดังกล่าวเป็น๑๓๐๐ดอลลาร์และเงินเดือนรองผู้ว่าราชการจังหวัดย่อยบอนตอกเป็น๑๕๐๐ดอลลาร์ต่อปี
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 410 tentang organisasi Provinsi Lepanto-Bontoc dengan menaikkan gaji Sekretaris-Bendahara di provinsi tersebut menjadi 1300 dolar dan gaji Letnan-Gubernur Subprovinsi Bontoc menjadi 1500 dolar per tahun
title.ms: Akta mengubah Akta Nombor 410 mengenai penubuhan Wilayah Lepanto-Bontoc dengan meningkatkan gaji Setiausaha-Bendahari di wilayah berkenaan kepada 1300 dolar dan gaji Timbalan Ketua Menteri Subwilayah Bontoc kepada 1500 dolar setahun

text.en:
Suction two of Act Numbered Four hundred and ten, providing for the organization of the
Province of Lepanto-Bontoc, is hereby amended by striking out subsection (b) thereof and inserting in lieu
thereof the following:
"(b) A provincial secretary-treasurer who shall receive compensation at the rate of one,thousand three
hundred dollars per year."

Section three of Act Numbered Four hundred and ten is hereby amended by striking out the words
"fourteen hundred dollars" in the sixth line of said section and inserting in lieu thereof the words "one
thousand five hundred dollars."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 22, 1902.
